vectors.evidence: One obligation and one accrual expense per contract period; a partial day-60 wage is later fully cleared on the same obligation by a retry.
Zero-fund settlements commit WageArrearsRecorded and immutable failed settlement rows while the scheduler reaches day 90 without hidden cash creation.
Reverse physical insertion yields identical events and replay hash through delinquency; rent grace, failed settlement reason, and past-due state remain queryable.
Two funded buyers race the last authoritative stock unit; one complete write set commits and one receives BRANCH_VERSION_CONFLICT, with zero stock and no negative inventory.
Same canonical request returns the original result with unchanged counts; changed payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.
Pre-COMMIT injection leaves no partial write; post-delivery/pre-mark crash survives reopen and redelivers while consumer dedupe applies one effect.
Empty replay and snapshot continuation match; corruption is detected; projection repair leaves immutable event, Posting, and StockMovement counts unchanged.

Unauthorized and over-limit requests write nothing; authorized 10000000 issuance records source, grant, policy usage, InterventionRecord, audit, balanced postings, event, and Outbox without changing price.
Cohort materialization is outside the M1 exit scope.

The M1 backend query and transport boundary passes player self-scope, creator instance/branch scope, field escalation denial, operator redaction, opaque cursor pagination, cross-principal cursor rejection, hidden-event filtering, SSE reconnect, heartbeat, and cancellation over a real HTTP connection. M4 UI consumption remains deferred.
Migration/schema epoch constraints remain, but runtime hot activation is explicitly deferred to M3.
The strict M1 world enables one integer currency and no FX feature; cross-currency settlement is not claimed.
